name: Cape Adventure Playground
text: An adventure playground at 85 Crouch Hill. Run by Awesome Adventure Play for children aged 6 and over who live or go to school in Islington (register with them first). Term time: Monday to Friday 3:15pm to 6:15pm; Saturday Family Play for all ages with a parent or carer, 11:30am to 4:30pm.

name: Hayward Adventure Playground
text: An inclusive adventure playground on Market Road for children and young people with special educational needs and disabilities, run by the charity KIDS. Places are by registration or referral: after-school club Monday to Thursday and Saturday club for ages 6 to 15, with teenage and youth clubs too.
